title: The Jinn Are Created
notes: That the jinn lived on earth before Adam, building and spreading strife, comes from early commentators such as Ibn Abbas, not from the words of the Quran.
imagePrompt: The young earth at dusk under a smouldering red sky; from the horizon a smokeless flame, blue at its core and orange at its edges, twists upward and splits into countless small flickering fire-forms spreading over mountains and desert like fire carried on wind; ghostly silhouettes of towers rising and crumbling in time-lapse; drifting embers; warm reds against dark parchment; restless, powerful, wild.

beats.say: Before humankind, Allah created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

verse.en: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

beats.say: They spread over mountains and deserts like fire carried on the wind, building and roaming.
Their cities rose and crumbled; early commentators say they filled the earth with strife.

verse.en: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.
